lesson: For the pre-materialization XLSX guard in sap-actuals.parser.ts use: total uncompressed bytes <= 256 MB and ZIP entry count <= 256, enforced WHILE reading the archive (reject before full materialization). These are generous for a legitimate SAP Base Report (639KB compressed, ~4k rows, single sheet -> a few MB uncompressed and ~15 entries) yet block zip-bombs (which target GB-scale expansion) and entry-count bombs. Combine with the existing 15 MB compressed cap and 25,000-row cap.
